newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - U.S. Rentals sees gain.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - U.S. Rentals sees gain.

text.p: The initial public offerings that made their debuts on Friday stirred up greater interest than deals that came to market earlier in the week, with U.S. Rentals Inc topping the list of most active stocks on the Big Board in late morning activity.

U.S. Rentals' shares, which priced in the middle of their $19 to $21 range at $20, opened at 22-1/2 and then moved back to 21-3/8, with over 5.2 million shares trading hands by late morning. The Modesto, Calif.- based equipment rental company's 10 million share deal was lead managed by Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.

Brylane Inc's four million share deal had a more modest debut than was expected by analysts, who had seen a 0.75 to one point gain at the open. Shares were at 24-1/8, up 1/8 from their offering price of $24, on volume of 1.4 million shares.
The clothing catalog company's IPO, lead managed by Merrill Lynch, priced at the lower end of its $24 to $26 range.

Overland Data Inc, which priced at the top of its $8 to $10 per share range, snapped up a premium of 1-1/8 to rise to 11-1/8. Jefferies & Co was lead manager on the deal, which was raised to three million shares from an earlier estimation of 2.7 million shares.
The San Diego, Calif.-based company designs and manufactures magnetic tape data storage systems used for backup, archival and data interchange functions.
ILEX Oncology Inc's 2.5 million share issue priced at $12, and rose 3/4 to 12-3/4. The deal was lead-managed by Salomon Brothers.
ILEX is a drug development company focused on drugs for the treatment and prevention of cancer.
